use.title: Use Vault SSH signing
use.description: Create Vault signer profiles and connect to hosts that use Vault.

redirectUri.description: Add this URL to allowed_redirect_uris in each Vault OIDC role that Termix signs in with.

legacyCallback.label: Use the old redirect URI
legacyCallback.description: Keep sending /vault/oidc/callback, the redirect URI used before 2.9. Turn this off once your Vault roles allow the new one.
